description_target.target_text: remove tip of each non-target shape, add 3-cell bar at opposite end of target

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (bg 8)
         (shapes (objects-8 g bg))
         ;; Compute info for each shape
         (shape-infos
          (map (lambda (o)
                 (let* ((cells (obj-cells o))
                        (color (obj-color o))
                        (bb (obj-bbox o))
                        (size (length cells))
                        (cr (/ (- h 1) 2.0))
                        (cc (/ (- w 1) 2.0))
                        ;; Find tip: cell closest to grid center
                        (tip
                         (let loop ((cs cells) (best #f) (best-d 1e18))
                           (cond
                             ((null? cs) best)
                             (else
                              (let* ((c (car cs))
                                     (cr2 (first c))
                                     (cc2 (second c))
                                     (d (+ (* (- cr2 cr) (- cr2 cr))
                                           (* (- cc2 cc) (- cc2 cc)))))
                                (if (< d best-d)
                                    (loop (cdr cs) c d)
                                    (loop (cdr cs) best best-d))))))))
                   (list color cells (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb) size tip)))
               shapes))
         ;; Find target (largest by size)
         (target
          (let loop ((ss shape-infos) (best #f) (best-size -1))
            (cond
              ((null? ss) best)
              (else
               (let* ((si (car ss)) (sz (seventh si)))
                 (if (> sz best-size)
                     (loop (cdr ss) si sz)
                     (loop (cdr ss) best best-size)))))))
         (target-color (first target))
         (target-r1 (third target))
         (target-c1 (fourth target))
         (target-r2 (fifth target))
         (target-c2 (sixth target))
         (target-tip (eighth target))
         (tip-r (first target-tip))
         (tip-c (second target-tip))
         (body-cr (/ (+ target-r1 target-r2) 2.0))
         (body-cc (/ (+ target-c1 target-c2) 2.0))
	         (dr-t (- tip-r body-cr))
	         (dc-t (- tip-c body-cc))
	         (paint-bar
	          (lambda (base cells)
	            (paint-cells base
	                         (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) h w)) cells)
	                         target-color)))
	         (g1
	          ;; Remove tips of non-target shapes
	          (erase-cells g
	                       (map eighth (filter (lambda (si) (not (equal? si target))) shape-infos))
	                       bg))
	         (g2
	          ;; Add cells for target
	          (cond
	            ((> (abs dr-t) (abs dc-t))
	             (if (> dr-t 0)
	                 (let ((new-row (- target-r1 1)))
	                   (paint-bar g1 (map (lambda (dc) (list new-row (+ tip-c dc))) (list -1 0 1))))
	                 (let ((new-row (+ target-r2 1)))
	                   (paint-bar g1 (map (lambda (dc) (list new-row (+ tip-c dc))) (list -1 0 1))))))
	            (else
	             (if (> dc-t 0)
	                 (let ((new-col (- target-c1 1)))
	                   (paint-bar g1 (map (lambda (dr) (list (+ tip-r dr) new-col)) (list -1 0 1))))
	                 (let ((new-col (+ target-c2 1)))
	                   (paint-bar g1 (map (lambda (dr) (list (+ tip-r dr) new-col)) (list -1 0 1)))))))))
    g2)))
